extraction.notes: Pass 1 full extraction from the converted text file under extraction rules 0.4 and themes 1.3. Read the table of contents (pages 2-3), the introduction and the whole report summary (pages 4-9), the whole Cluster 2 introduction and Chapter 2 section (pages 67-70), and screened every other section with the table of contents and a keyword search (digital, electronic, e-, online, data, cyber, artificial intelligence, interoperab, broadband, identification, portal, internet, ICT, software, information system, platform, website, technology), reading each hit in its surrounding paragraph; pages read in full where the hits were dense: democracy (10), public administration reform (14-18), Chapter 23 (21, 24, 28-29, 33-34), Chapter 24 (38-40), economic criteria (52-56), Chapter 5 (57-59), regional cooperation (65-66), Chapters 1, 3, 4, 6 and 7 (67-74), Chapter 28 (77-78), Chapters 10 and 16 (79-81), Chapter 19 (84), Chapter 26 (88-89), Chapter 29 (90), Chapters 27 and 22 (97, 101-102) and Annex I (108). Period covered taken from footnote 2 of the report (June 2020 to June 2021) because the register field is empty. Text-file page numbers are printed page numbers plus one. The 2021 report has no chapter-by-chapter summary: Chapter 2 is rated in the report summary (page 8), the Cluster 2 introduction (page 67) and the Chapter 2 section (pages 69-70); all three are extracted (R10). No anti-corruption measure is tied to Chapter 2 in this report. Not extracted as outside the theme test: court case management (ACCMIS), IFMIS and the human resources management information system, the IT tools of the access to information agency, the EU integration and donor coordination IT systems, the Open Finance portal and other online publishing, interception of communications, cybercrime statistics and computer crime law, the IPR enforcement data platform, the euro counterfeiting case system, the central register of bank accounts, customs and excise IT (CDEPS, SEED), the social assistance IT system, statistical office IT, road crash data, LPIS, FADN and animal identification, electronic management of EU funds, the 112 emergency number, media and online media items, generic references to new technologies and innovation funding, digital skills not linked to a recommendation, and Cluster 3 summary sentences that rate several chapters together. The statistical annex (pages 109-114) was not extracted: its broadband and internet rows cover 2008 and 2015 to 2019, before the run window. Doubtful theme cases are flagged theme_doubtful for the analyst. Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2), see review/RUN-2026-01/second_pass/.
